Kwame, I replied in the #coastal-team thread.

The only Saltmarsh discount figures in this channel are from Nov 17, 2025. Bettina first posted 12%, then corrected it to 10%, saying she had misread a draft worksheet from June. The last figure posted here is 10%, but it's almost a year old and I can't confirm it's still the contracted rate. For the current number, check with June Osei-Lark on deal desk, or with Sofia Marchetti, who runs the Saltmarsh account.
